output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner {
output_list.reason: The devaleued token owner has the right to mint more tokens, that is effectively devalue the token. It is recommended that the mintToken function can only be called by the contract owner in the first place. If the contract owner still wants to mint, he can just mint less tokens than requested. More importantly, the mintToken function currently does not prevent the owner from minting more tokens than they actually have. This vulnerability will be exploited by minters with less funds to sell their tokens and create a large number of tokens in circulation. To devalue token, the tokens should not be just minted, but with a reduction in token distribution.
